title: Velocity before collision
description: Essential: Correctly applies work-energy theorem to find ball A's speed as sqrt(2EqL/(3m)).

title: Conservation of momentum
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation for inelastic collision to find post-collision speed.

title: Energy loss calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes lost mechanical energy as (1/4)EqL from kinetic energy difference.

title: Impulse on ball B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates impulse magnitude as m*(post-collision speed) or equivalent.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for impulse direction or misinterprets vector nature.

title: Algebraic simplification
description: Important: Shows correct algebraic manipulation to reach final simplified forms.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Explicitly states or verifies units for final answers (m/s, J, N·s).

title: Force work omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to equate electric force work (EqL) to kinetic energy gain for part (1).
